title: Characterization of stack addresses
statement: For natural numbers $q,Q$ and an integer $a$, write $c(j)=-2j$ for each natural number $j$, and let the stack address set consist of the values $c(j)$ with $q\le j<Q$. Then $a$ belongs to this set if and only if $c(Q)<a\le c(q)$ and $2$ divides $a$.
